claim_text: The Tension Between Control and Exploration There's an interesting duality in interaction design: - Templates like `design-playground.md` and `data-explorer.md` emphasize direct manipulation (sliders, toggles, dropdowns) - While `concept-map.md` and `code-map.md` prioritize open exploration (drag-to-arrange, click-to-connect) The prompt generation logic in each reveals different philosophies: - Data/design prompts generate specifications ("Make it with X properties") - Concept/code map prompts generate learning requests ("Explain these relationships to me") #### 3.
